p5.practice: Skill practice · not a reported company question

p5.interviewIntro: Practise one answer at a time. Review your transcript, then get specific feedback grounded in your own words.

help.title: How to use this page
help.pathIntro: Choose a job and see the skills to start learning. These are starting plans; employers may ask for more skills or qualifications.
help.path1: Choose the job you want from the career list.
help.path2: Pick a skill you already know and your level. Save it to update your plan.
help.path3: Read the learning steps below. Study times are estimates, not a promise of a job.
help.questionsIntro: Use this page to see questions shared by past candidates.
help.questions1: Choose a company and enter its job title, then press Search.
help.questions2: Read a question and try answering aloud. Open its source to check the original report.
help.questions3: For guided practice and feedback, open Interview practice. Past questions may not be asked again.
help.prepIntro: Turn your college placement notice into a daily study plan.
help.prep1: Paste your notice, or use the sample. Press Read notice.
help.prep2: Check the company, role and interview date. Correct any mistake and tick the confirmation box.
help.prep3: Choose your learning goal and daily study time. Build the plan, then open interview practice.
help.interviewIntro: Practise five questions and learn how to improve your answers.
help.interview1: Choose your company and role, then start the practice.
help.interview2: Type your answer, or record it and check the words before sending.
help.interview3: Read the feedback and try the next question. Feedback is practice help, not a hiring decision.
help.evidenceIntro: This page explains where DAARI gets information and what its checks can and cannot tell us. You do not need this page to search or practise.
help.evidence1: Source links let you check the original job notice, scheme or interview report.
help.evidence2: Test results show how the website performed on checked examples. A pass does not guarantee every answer is correct.
help.evidence3: Public means these checks are visible. Your private answers and placement notice are not published here.
